items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: He was on the road with Desdune's big band.

ctx.x: See that time, 10, 12, 14 bands get a job sometimes two, three times a week.

Yeah, and matter of fact, we had about nine big bands around here at one time and all of them were working. Because Sidney Deadbeam band was on the captain, the president wasn't here then, and P-Ron was on the JS. See? And they had Herbert Larry's band around here. He was on the road with Desdune's big band. See? And they had Clark's Brown Buddies.
Is that a local band? That was a local band.
